definitions.explanation: An endearing quality that makes someone or something attractive and likable.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{愛嬌|あいきょう}のある{顔|かお}をしている。
{愛嬌|あいきょう}を{振|ふ}りまく。
examples.english: To spread charm; to be charming to everyone.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}も{愛嬌|あいきょう}のうち。
examples.english: Even mistakes can be part of one's charm.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{愛嬌|あいきょう}がある - to have charm, be lovable
・{愛嬌|あいきょう}を{振|ふ}りまく - to be charming to everyone
・{愛嬌|あいきょう}のある{顔|かお} - a charming/likable face
・{失敗|しっぱい}も{愛嬌|あいきょう}のうち - mistakes are part of one's charm

NUANCE:
{愛嬌|あいきょう} often suggests a cute, endearing quality rather than mere friendliness. It can apply to people, animals, or even objects. The expression 「{失敗|しっぱい}も{愛嬌|あいきょう}のうち」 is used to downplay minor mistakes by saying they add to one's appeal.

COMPARISON WITH {愛想|あいそう}:
・{愛想|あいそう} - social friendliness, courtesy (more about behavior)
・{愛嬌|あいきょう} - personal charm, lovableness (more about innate appeal)
